fields.name: Map method
fields.definition: A data method whose results are built by the Mapper, as opposed to a Query method, which takes a caller-written result handler. There are three families. `MapReader*` builds the root model from a single-row data reader result. `MapOutput*` builds it from output parameters. `MapList*` returns one model per row. MapReader and MapOutput can also fill up to eight result-set list properties from further result sets. On a shard set, the `First` and `All` suffixes select ReadFirst or ReadAll semantics.
